format: standard gzip containing unchanged UTF-8 JSONL event schema
buffers: 64 KiB input and 64 KiB output plus bounded zlib state
disk_flush: 250 ms batching, explicit flush barrier and final drain/CRC
sample_scope: selected real Windows-session events; not a full-log benchmark
native_checks: gzip CRC, JSON parsing, sequence, live and idle flush, Unicode paths, loss markers, decompressed redaction, fatal-process prefix passed
reader_checks: legacy plain, gzip, truncated recovery, concatenated members, no overwrite passed
windows_and_physical_station: not run here; zlib dependency added to Windows/Ubuntu/Fedora CI
